The focus is sharp on the foreground food and the rim of the pan, with the background handle blurring into darkness. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the texture of the food and the sheen of the oil.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the searing food appears slightly 'smudged' or painterly where it meets the bubbling oil. The boundary between the solid food and the liquid fat lacks crisp physical definition, showing slight melting/fusion artifacts common in AI food generation.

The rim of the pan on the right side seems to lose its defined thickness and blends slightly into the dark background, lacking the sharp, hard edge expected of metal. This is subtle but noticeable upon close inspection.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a frying pan and not a similar kitchen vessel like a wok or sauté pan, and to verify material classification.
To analyze the complex fluid dynamics of the bubbling oil and the texture of the searing food for signs of AI generation artifacts (melting, unnatural bubbles).
To verify the structural integrity of the pan's edge and check for any topological errors where the handle meets the body or where the rim fades into the background.

Physical plausibility of the bubbling oil and searing marks on the food
Consistency of the pan's material texture (cast iron vs non-stick)
